kind: desensitized run-level recompute material (no raw frame arrays, no machine paths)

method.noiseRule: max(3 percent, 2 * baseline run-median MAD / baseline median * 100)
method.drift: each cell ordered by unique sequence; median last3 vs first2; abs change above noise threshold makes comparison INCONCLUSIVE
decisionOrder: invalid input or missing runs => INVALID
noise <=5 percent without sufficient decrease => REJECTED

protected.gpuFrameMs: positive samples only; coverage >=99 percent; median of run medians; <=5 percent regression
protected.residentBytes: median of run medians <=5 percent regression; transient pool only
protected.hitch: common baseline pooled median + 5*MAD threshold; if MAD zero use 3*median; candidate rate <= baseline rate + max(0.01,0.05*baseline rate)
protected.unavailable: allocation counters excluded, never interpreted as zero allocations

method.exclusion: No silent exclusion or replacement; failed run aborts group, retain all attempts. New protocol/ID required for a restart.

limitations: Run-level statistics only; verifying per-frame medians themselves requires the local raw files.
Single machine, five runs per cell, D3D12, VSync off; not a cross-machine or generic speedup claim.
Historical C-M9-002 identity gap and BLOCKED status are unchanged by this material.
